batch: Revamp S2 Customer Work: follow-up to PR 355 (G4 workspace lifecycle and G5 account lifecycle, installed and enabled), fixing the four Codex findings and the post-merge Guardian findings
kind: Reports to docs/revamp/crud/summary.md rows G4 and G5. Requirements: V3-06-002, V3-06-003, V3-06-006, V3-05-055.
findingsNote: Sensitive: yes (migrations on installed modules, triggers on member-role tables, session boundary sign-in check). The owner merges. Migrations are additive new files only; no applied file is edited.
fixed: Account screens and the closed-account screen send the page identity (subject and issuer) on the state read and every command; a source scan lists every state-changing client under app/account, components and lib

A former owner (demoted admin) cannot be removed, demoted or leave through a false success: the server refuses with a plain reason (BEFORE INSERT guards on workspace_access_revocation and workspace_member_role), the team list shows the true role, and Leave is not offered to them
Account close and workspace provisioning take the same person lifecycle lock, and provisioning refuses a closed account

Undo, later closure events and the staff erasure steps use the workspace of the original closure or request (append-only account_chain, backfilled from existing events), so a member removed from their only workspace can still undo and be erased
Closing and erasure words state facts only (no hidden-workspaces claim, no separate reviewed file step); the final undo refusal is true with or without an erasure request
A closed person can still ask for erasure, with a confirm dialog on the closed screen
The erasure queue is split sample and real by the chain workspace and the person's current workspaces
Late fingerprint re-checks restore or refuse if submit_private_request or workspace_access_command lose the archive gate
Close, archive, ownership offer and accept need a sign-in within 15 minutes (session createdAt), with a sign-in-again path; undo, erasure, restore, rename, cancel and decline do not
migrations: customer-workspace-lifecycle-migrations 0005 member protection, 0006 provisioning closed account, 0007 archive gate late, 0008 member role guard late, 0009 keeps access in state
customer-account-lifecycle-migrations 0002 account chain and undo words, 0003 erasure queue scope, 0004 erasure scope by workspaces
upgradeProof: tests/integration/revamp-g4-g5-upgrade.test.ts builds the shipped modules from fixtures byte-identical to main, installs them in production order, creates data with the old functions, pauses the account control, then runs the new migrations: only the expected functions change, recorded hashes and control values are untouched, a re-run changes nothing, a tampered applied hash still refuses, and the upgraded database equals a fresh install.
knownLimits: Whether the live provider returns session.createdAt is not verified; if it does not, close, archive, offer and accept refuse with the sign-in-again message (fails closed). Check on a preview deployment.
Revocation rows for former owners that already exist in production stay as they are
A handover recipient cannot leave their own workspace without support
Filing erasure is refused while the account control is paused
About ten account pages read the provider session directly, so the shell makes one extra read for them (follow-up: share the cached read)
The sign-in page decides which return destinations it honours
notRun: ClamAV, Blob and pg_dump backup tests need Docker containers and fail in this environment (they do not touch these files).
